Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning a business and occupation tax deduction for certified community development financial institutions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a business and occupation tax deduction forcertified community development financial institutions; adding a newsection to chapter 82.04 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In computing tax there may be deducted from the measure of taxby an eligible entity, interest received on loans issued by theeligible entity as part of a firsttime home buyer program. (2) The definitions in this subsection apply to this section. (a) "Eligible entity" means a nonprofit organization certified asa community development financial institution by the federal communitydevelopment financial institutions fund. (b) "Nonprofit organization" means an organization incorporatedunder chapter 24.03 RCW.
This act applies to interest received on or p. 1 SB 5363after August 1, 2011.
